items.title: BofA: the 'AI trade' is the US Treasury market's 'last line of defence'
items.summary: Bank of America warns the AI narrative is acting as a 'buffer' against macro risks; once that narrative cracks, all suppressed macro risks will amplify at once and stocks will face a real shock.

items.summary_zh: 美国银行警告， AI叙事正在充当宏观风险的"缓冲垫"，一旦这一叙事出现裂痕，所有被压制的宏观风险将同步放大，股市将面临真正的冲击
